newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse first-tier slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse first-tier slightly up.

text.p: Prices on the Bucharest bourse's first tier recovered slightly on Friday when trading was quiet due to investors' summer holiday mood, brokers said.
"It's true that some first-tier prices went up slighlty but you shouldn't expect anything spectacular over the next few days. It was a mere correction of prices," one said.
The closing prices of 18 stocks inched up, 21 went down and five were flat. One stock stayed suspended and another had no trades.
Volume inched down to 1.96 million shares from 2.39 million on Thursday, while the turnover slipped to 7.96 billion lei from 8.68 billion previously.
"Trading was calm as the majority of investors and brokers preferred to have a quiet summer holiday and liquidated their portfolios before taking off," one broker said.

Brokers said first-tier stock listing Azomures Sa fertiliser maker had made a "strong" comeback by gaining 200 lei to close at 3,700, followed by Compa Sibiu car spare parts maker which ended 50 lei stronger at 2,700.

Second-tier newcomer UCMR SA hydro equipment maker had a modest entry with 60 shares changing hands while another newcomer, the Zimtub SA welded pipe manufacturer, failed to attract investors' interest.
Brokers said most second-tier stocks recorded "significant" losses on Friday, including Grimex SA mininig equipment firm which lost 3,800 lei to close at 16,200.

Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, were up slightly from Thursday's session, posting increases of 0.5, 0.32 and 0.45 percent respectively.
